source.fen_method: Manual transcription of rendered diagrams; Ganguly from book opening sequence. Legal board and played SAN validated. Halfmove clocks reset to zero where historical value unknown; no repetition claims.

fresh_cases.book_question_not_automatic_truth: Quiet bishop redeployment and rook route release; distinguish later e8–g6–e4 plan from immediate d7 occupancy. Preserve any exchange price and reply that interrupts the route.

Pawn lever can open f-file and bishop d7–e8–g6 route. Do not infer both purposes merely from destination. If the reply trades or closes the pawn contact, connect the changed piece function and price; e6 weakness is a book hypothesis, not an engine-certified loss.
Missed prophylaxis: ...Ne4 and ...b4 differ if Bg5 pins the f6 knight. Explain the actual evaluation pair and observed prevention/permission, not the book verdict by authority.

Rook attack preparation vs pawn weakness: ...Qc6 attacks c2 and changes when c4 can be played; ...Nc8 challenges original Nd6. Preserve the opponent idea if observed, and do not call delayed c4 equivalent solely by reaching c4.

Central pawn lever: attack d4 and release c8 bishop. Accept current engine reference; retain actual d5/dxe5 response, pawn cost and resulting activity if observed. No claim of forced pawn recovery from the book alone.

Quiet king prophylaxis before Ne5: a change to potential checks/tempo must have an observed witness. Do not invent improved king safety from the destination or declare all continuations strategically equivalent.

historical_corpus: Survey.scala fixed eight fixture files; 16 rows include repeated positions. Exact replay work mismatch is a recorded limitation, not license to transplant an old report. Counts reported as unique positions separately.
quality_axes: Actual evaluated pair is the owner; neither book best move nor easier alternative replaces it.
Root purpose or explicitly bounded uncertainty is visible in basic commentary.
At least one observed reply and consequent function/role change are connected where present.
Selected captures, intervening checks, sacrificed material, lost current obligations, exact physical identity and finite-PV boundary remain covered.
Repeated facts are grouped by meaning and ownership, not string match, same role, or same square alone.
Compare same saved report before/after for length; actual browser read for quality and 10-second request behavior.
held_out_protocol: Do not request engine output or inspect product commentary for held_out cases until a shared implementation has passed development checks. Any held-out failure stays recorded as held-out; later fixing it does not make it independent success.
scope_limit: No requirement that every literary long plan fits D<=18/10sec. Any unsupported long-term purpose remains a failed/limited type; must not claim total generalized completion.
